def find_initial_position(n, x):
    # The pattern of swaps repeats every 2 moves
    # The ball moves through the positions 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 1 -> 0 -> 1, etc.
    # We can use this pattern to determine the initial position
    # If n is even, the ball ends up at the same position it started
    # If n is odd, the ball ends up at the opposite position
    if n % 2 == 0:
        # If n is even, the ball ends up at the same position it started
        return x
    else:
        # If n is odd, the ball ends up at the opposite position
        if x == 0:
            return 1
        elif x == 1:
            return 0
        else:
            return 1

# Read input
n = int(input().strip())
x = int(input().strip())

# Output the initial position of the ball
print(find_initial_position(n, x))
